newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed lower across the board in moderate trade on some late local selling interest in line with weaker Japanese prices, brokers said on Monday.

They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were marked down slightly as the market, pressured by easier overseas markets and a lack of buying interest, failed to gain ground after the spot January contract expired higher at noon.
"The (local) market was quiet and featureless in the morning," a local broker said.
"But prices were marked down slightly in the afternoon on some speculative selling in sympathy with softer prices in Tokyo and Kobe. Volume was moderate," she added.
At around 0945 GMT, April RSS3 fell one cent to 120.50 U.S. cents a kg.
July/September RSS1 fell 1.50 cents to 174.00 Singapore cents (US$1.24) a kg.
February TSR20 fell one cent to 164.75 Singapore cents (US$1.18) a kg.
